fault_specifications.name: High Overnight Baseload Override
fault_specifications.description: HVAC air handler manual override and corridor lighting left on during off-hours.
fault_specifications.suggested_action: Inspect BAS schedule overrides on AHU-1/AHU-2 and occupancy sensor timeouts.

fault_specifications.name: Sudden Midday Peak Surge
fault_specifications.description: Simultaneous uncoordinated chiller stage-up and heavy high-draw autoclave cycle.
fault_specifications.suggested_action: Review chiller sequencing and schedule peak load shedding.

fault_specifications.name: Persistent Baseload Drift
fault_specifications.description: Hydronic cooling bypass valve leaking; secondary circulation pump running continuously.
fault_specifications.suggested_action: Inspect secondary pump VFDs and hydronic 3-way control valve seating.
